chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام said:

During the month of Ramadan, hold fast to abundant seeking forgiveness and supplication. As for supplication, it repels affliction from you; and as for seeking forgiveness, your sins are erased by it.

key_terms.الدُّعَاءِ: supplication; calling upon Allah in prayer
key_terms.الِاسْتِغْفَارِ: seeking forgiveness from Allah for one's sins
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the sacred time of fasting and intensified devotion

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام recommend doing frequently in the month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام urges the believers to increase both istighfar and du'a in the month of Ramadan. The hadith highlights two spiritual benefits: du'a repels affliction, and istighfar becomes a means for the erasure of sins.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1858 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"During the Month of Ramadan, engage abundantly in seeking forgiveness and supplication. As for supplication, it wards off affliction from you, and as for seeking forgiveness, it erases your sins."
